about: Newell Brands (formerly Newell Rubbermaid) is a consumer goods company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. Its portfolio includes Rubbermaid, Sharpie, Paper Mate, Graco, Coleman, Yankee Candle, Oster, Mr. Coffee, Crock-Pot, Calphalon and FoodSaver, sold mostly through mass retailers and online. Sales are about $7 billion. Listed on Nasdaq (NWL). Customers are consumers and retailers worldwide, strong household brands.

wiki.title: Newell Brands
wiki.text: Newell Brands Inc. is an American conglomerate of consumer and commercial products. The company's brands and products include Rubbermaid storage/or waste disposal containers; home organization and reusable container products; Contigo and Bubba water bottles; Coleman outdoor products; writing instruments (Berol, Expo Markers, Paper Mate, Dymo, Mr. Sketch, Parker Pens, Sharpie, Reynolds, Prismacolor, Rotring, X-acto, Waterman) glue (Elmer's, Krazy Glue); children's products (Aprica, NUK, Tigex, Babysun, Baby Jogger and Graco); cookware and small appliances (Calphalon, Sunbeam, Rival, Crock-Pot; Holmes, FoodSaver, Oster, Osterizer, and Mr. Coffe

about: Hanesbrands is a Winston-Salem, North Carolina apparel company making basics under the Hanes, Bonds, Maidenform, Playtex and Bali brands (it sold its Champion activewear brand to Authentic Brands in 2024). It sells innerwear and basics through mass retailers, wholesale and online in the Americas, Australia and Europe, with revenue of roughly $3.5 billion. Listed on NYSE (HBI); Gildan agreed to acquire it in 2025. Household brand with large consumer recognition.

wiki.title: Hanesbrands
wiki.text: Hanesbrands Inc. is an American multinational clothing company based in Winston-Salem, North Carolina. Employing 65,300 people internationally, it owns several clothing brands, including Hanes, Playtex, Bali, L'eggs, Just My Size, Barely There, Wonderbra, Maidenform, Berlei, and Bonds. The company was acquired by Gildan in 2025.

about: Rappi is an on-demand delivery super app founded in Bogota in 2015 and now also headquartered in Mexico City, operating in Latin America, including Colombia, Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Chile, Peru and Costa Rica. It delivers restaurant meals, groceries, pharmacy items and cash, with RappiPay credit cards and Rappi Prime subscriptions. Backed by SoftBank, Andreessen Horowitz and Sequoia with about $2.5 billion raised. Very high consumer brand awareness across Latin America, with sponsorship of football and events.

wiki.title: Rappi
wiki.text: Rappi is a Colombian super-app headquartered in Bogotá, Colombia, with offices in São Paulo and Mexico City. It was founded in 2015.

about: Trade Republic is a Berlin-based neobroker and savings app founded in 2015, letting Europeans buy stocks, ETFs, crypto and derivatives, set up savings plans and hold a Trade Republic card, backed by a German banking licence. It serves millions of retail customers across Germany, France, Italy, Spain and other European countries. It was valued at around 5 billion euros in 2025 and earns order-flow payments, interest and card fees. Strong brand among young European consumers.

wiki.title: Trade Republic
wiki.text: Trade Republic Bank GmbH is a German online broker and bank headquartered in Berlin. Founded in 2015, it offers brokerage services through a mobile app and initially relied in part on payment for order flow (PFOF), a practice later phased out in the European Union. After receiving a full banking licence from the European Central Bank in 2023, the company expanded into savings and current-account products. As of April 2025, it had 8 million users in 17 countries and €100 billion in assets.

about: Essity is a Stockholm-based Swedish hygiene and health company, spun out of SCA in 2017, making Tork professional hygiene, TENA incontinence care, Libero, Libresse, Bodyform, Leukoplast and JOBST products. It sells in about 150 countries, with revenue near SEK 140 billion and about 36,000 employees. Listed on Nasdaq Stockholm (ESSITY-B). Customers are consumers, healthcare and businesses. Many strong consumer brands in Europe, including Libero and Bodyform.

wiki.title: Essity
wiki.text: Essity AB (commonly known as Essity) is a Swedish multinational company specializing in hygiene and health products headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. Established in 2017 through a spin-off from the forest products company Svenska Cellulosa Aktiebolaget (SCA), Essity operates in approximately 150 countries and serves more than one billion people worldwide with its range of products Essity's name is derived from the words "essentials" and "necessity," reflecting its focus on essential hygiene and health products. Essity's range of products includes personal care items, consumer tissue products, professional hygiene solutions, and medical care

about: Whatnot is a Los Angeles-based live shopping marketplace, founded in 2019, where sellers sell collectibles such as trading cards, sneakers, comics, toys and fashion by live video, and buyers bid in real time via the app. It operates in the US, UK and Germany, earning commissions. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz, CapitalG and DST, and valued at about $5 billion in 2025. Strong consumer brand among collectors and growing in live commerce.

wiki.title: Whatnot
wiki.text: Whatnot is a digital marketplace and live-stream shopping platform where users can buy and sell items in online video auctions. The company was incorporated in Delaware but is based in Marina Del Rey, California. Whatnot's slogan is "Shop, Sell, Connect". It is the largest live shopping platform in the United States.

about: Walmart is the world's largest retailer by revenue, headquartered in Bentonville, Arkansas and listed on the NYSE and Nasdaq (WMT), operating around 10,500 stores in 19 countries including Walmart US, Sam's Club, Walmart International and Flipkart/PhonePe stakes, with about 2.1 million employees and revenue above 640 billion dollars. Founded 1962 by Sam Walton. Customers are mainstream shoppers; also runs advertising (Walmart Connect). Extremely recognisable consumer brand with a large advertising business of its own.

wiki.title: Walmart
wiki.text: Walmart Inc. is an American multinational omnichannel retail corporation that operates a chain of hypermarkets (also called supercenters), discount department stores, grocery stores, pharmacies, and gas stations in the United States and 19 other countries. It is headquartered in Bentonville, Arkansas. The company was founded in 1962 by brothers Sam Walton and James "Bud" Walton in nearby Rogers, Arkansas. It also owns and operates Sam's Club retail warehouses. As of 2026, Walmart is the second-largest company by revenue globally and the largest private employer in the world, with 2.1 million employees. The company is ranked two in the Fortune

about: Primo Brands is a North American bottled water and drinking water solutions company, headquartered in Tampa, Florida and listed on the NYSE (PRMB). It was created in November 2024 by the merger of Primo Water and BlueTriton, owning Poland Spring, Pure Life, Deer Park, Arrowhead, Ozarka, Saratoga, Mountain Valley, plus water dispensers, exchange and refill services. Revenue is about 7 billion dollars, with delivery to homes and offices. Strong consumer brands in US supermarkets and convenience stores.

wiki.title: Primo Brands
wiki.text: Primo Brands Corporation (previously known as Cott Corporation) is an American water company offering multi-gallon bottled water, water dispensers, self-service refill water machines, and water filtration appliances. The company is headquartered in Tampa, Florida, and services residential and commercial customers across the United States, Canada, Europe and Israel.
